structured.approach: I followed BE-05 in the backend-steps skill and read every contracted input in full: task.components, feat.design, feat.stories, org.engineering_stack and org.lessons. I also read feat.clarifications (DES-03) with context_get, to look for answers on the version step and on where tests go. Before editing I read the source, callers and blast radius of the symbols I would change, with the codegraph CLI. I then made the smallest additive change listed in task.components (A1 to A6, I1 to I3), following feat.design B3.2. I documented it in docs/ap_aging.md and README.md, as the brief asks. To confirm the result I called the CodeGraph MCP tool codegraph_explore on the changed and reused symbols, which returned their current source and blast radius. I ran `codegraph sync` and `codegraph affected` on the changed files, then ran the CI from the repository root. Compile, the existing tests and the static checks pass. Coverage is 71.4 against the 90.0 gate, because the two new functions have no tests yet. Tests are outside this step's write scope and belong to BE-06, so I report a failed CI instead of working around it. Nothing is committed, and task.secrets_scope was not needed.

claims.text: overdue_with_risk(invoices: Iterable[Dict], as_of: date, risk_by_vendor: Dict[str, str]) -> List[Dict] is in src/ap_aging/aging.py. It skips invoices where inv.get("paid") is truthy and keeps only invoices with days_past_due > OVERDUE_AFTER_DAYS (30). Each row has exactly the keys id, vendor, days, amount (quantised with TWO_PLACES) and risk (default 'unknown'), and rows are sorted by (-days, id).
overdue_with_risk does not call bucket_for, because bucket_for(30) returns "31-60" while AC-05.2 says an invoice exactly 30 days past due is not listed.
overdue_rows_to_json(rows) -> str returns json.dumps of objects whose keys are in CT-1 order: id, vendor, days as int, amount as str(Decimal(...).quantize(TWO_PLACES)), and risk. It uses no float.
BUCKETS, days_past_due, bucket_for and aging_buckets keep their signatures and bodies; the change is additive only.
__init__.py exports aging_buckets, overdue_with_risk and overdue_rows_to_json in __all__. __version__ is 1.5.0, a minor step from 1.4.0 for the lane to confirm.

CodeGraph reports one caller each for overdue_with_risk and overdue_rows_to_json, in src/ap_aging/__init__.py, with no covering tests found. days_past_due, bucket_for and aging_buckets are covered by tests/test_aging.py.
CI result: compile true, 3 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors, no static issues, coverage 71.4. aging.py has 39 statements with 12 missed (lines 22, 47-63, 71). Overall passed is false.
The CI coverage gate is COVERAGE_MIN = 90.0, and the org stack requires line coverage of at least 90% in every CI.
git diff --stat reports 3 files changed, 62 insertions and 5 deletions. docs/ is new and untracked. Nothing is committed.
README.md is updated and docs/ap_aging.md is created because the brief asks for module documentation, although task.components listed README as unchanged.
Decisions D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 and lessons L-007 and L-011 are applied: calendar days via days_past_due, Decimal only, paid invoices excluded, and a strict > on the 30-day boundary.
